goal: Defeat Brock for the Boulder Badge

subgoals.goal_text: Travel back to Pallet Town to deliver the parcel to Professor Oak.
Enter Professor Oak's lab and give him the parcel.
Travel north through Viridian City and Route 2 to reach Pewter City.
Visit the Pewter City Pokemon Center to fully heal the party.
Battle wild Pokemon on Route 2 or Route 1 until Charmander is strong enough to face Brock (around level 12).
Enter the Pewter City Gym to challenge the leader.
Defeat Brock in battle to earn the Boulder Badge.
